certainty_values.FACT: Every step/claim is individually backed by an observed fact.
certainty_values.HYPOTHESIS: A structurally-plausible security-relevant question, never a verdict.
certainty_values.INFERENCE: Deterministically combined from multiple observed facts.
certainty_values._description: A second, narrower epistemic label used ONLY inside `properties` for the security-intelligence fact types (security_relationship_chain, access_controlled_function, unguarded_capability_hypothesis). It does not replace `status` — it exists because a single relationship CHAIN can mix steps of different certainty (e.g. one AST-verified step plus one co-occurrence-only step), which the base `status` field cannot express.

description: Recon-only static analysis output for Solidity/EVM repositories. Contains atomic, source-traceable facts and a structural graph. Contains no vulnerability, exploitability, severity, or mitigation judgments of any kind.

files.coverage.json: standalone multi-dimensional coverage report for the recon run
files.facts.jsonl: authoritative atomic fact database, one Fact per line
files.metadata.json: run metadata: versions, coverage inputs, timestamps, warnings/errors
files.snippets/: concise source snippets referenced by Evidence.snippet_path
files.summary.json: machine-readable index over facts/graph; not authoritative, derived from facts.jsonl+graph.json

fields.snippet_path: string|null — path under recon/ to the snippet text file

Evidence.file: not a separate top-level file; embedded inline in graph.json / referenced by id from facts.jsonl. Snippet bodies live under snippets/.

fields.confidence: 'high'|'medium'|'low' — EXTRACTION confidence, not a security rating
fields.id: string — stable id, sha1-derived from (type, file, ast node id, role)
fields.properties: object — atomic observed attributes for this fact type
fields.subject: object — what the fact is about (contract/function/state_variable refs)

SecurityIntelligenceLayer._description: Fact types introduced to connect otherwise-isolated facts into traceable relationships and a lightweight role/privilege map. Built entirely by cross-referencing already-extracted facts (recon/relationships.py) — no additional AST parsing. See certainty_values above.
SecurityIntelligenceLayer.access_controlled_function: A function with an observed authorization_check, either inline or via a modifier it uses. properties.mechanisms lists each mechanism found.
SecurityIntelligenceLayer.division_operation: Structural precursor for rounding/truncation/precision review: every integer division site plus its immediate consumer (return value / state write / variable initializer / call argument). Recon does not evaluate whether the resulting truncation is significant.
SecurityIntelligenceLayer.modifier_definition: A `modifier` declaration, inventoried the same way a function is.
SecurityIntelligenceLayer.security_relationship_chain: A short, ordered sequence of {actor, relation, target, certainty, basis_facts} steps connecting parameter control -> call target/calldata -> co-occurring asset operations, in the shape 'User -> controls -> parameter -> passed_into -> call -> co_occurs_with -> asset_operation'. Each step carries its own certainty; properties.overall_certainty is the weakest certainty among its steps.
SecurityIntelligenceLayer.unguarded_capability_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS-level: a function exercises a security-relevant capability (can_transfer_token, can_delegatecall, etc.) with no observed authorization_check anywhere in scope. An absence-of-evidence signal, not a finding — many functions are intentionally permissionless.

fields.ast_node_id: string|null — solc AST node id (unique within its compile group)
fields.start: int|null — byte offset in file content

status_values.derived: Deterministically inferred from one or more observed facts via disclosed heuristics.
status_values.observed: Directly represented by an AST/source node.
status_values.partial: Some but not all sub-parts of the relationship could be determined.
status_values.unknown: Could not be determined reliably from available information.
